verdict.rationale: OpenHands is a coding agent that runs actions in sandboxed backends and opens PRs with proposed fixes. Its SDK critic scores predicted success in real time during execution, which is a form of self-validation before results are proposed. No evidence item mentions the agent writing or running tests, so self-validation is only indirectly supported. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic test generation, documentation of executing test suites to verify changes before opening a PR, hands-on or independent corroboration.
